aria: Animated recap of the Heat's 115 to 109 road win at Utah: Giannis Antetokounmpo's 3-pointer with 4:51 left in the third quarter that made it 85 to 66, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 30 points and 11 rebounds, the top scorers, how the Heat won, and the next game against Cleveland.
notes: Box score from the Heat's 115–109 road win over the Utah Jazz at the Delta Center on Nov 10, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from Field Level Media (via The Sports Leader), Hot Hot Hoops, the Deseret News, KSL Sports, Ball Exclusives (via Yardbarker), VAVEL and the SI.com play-by-play. All 115 Heat points and all 109 Jazz points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (64–54 at the half, matching VAVEL; 92–72 after three, matching Ball Exclusives). The 23-point lead (89–66 late in the third) is from Covers, Field Level Media and the SI.com play-by-play; Utah's 7-point lead is Covers'. Team totals (turnovers, free throws, steals, points in the paint, fast-break points) are Covers'; the 25 points off turnovers are Field Level Media's and the Deseret News'. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Tuesday's games: Miami 5–6 and eighth in the East, Utah 1–10, Cleveland 5–6.

Utah won the fourth quarter 37–23. Isaiah Collier, who scored 15 of his 17 in the fourth, hit three straight 3-pointers to cap a 21–6 run that cut it to 101–93 with 6:42 left, before Antetokounmpo scored three baskets in two minutes to restore a double-digit lead (Field Level Media). Darryn Peterson fouled out with 4:35 left (Field Level Media). Utah has lost nine straight (Field Level Media, Ball Exclusives) and played without Keyonte George (Deseret News). Miami finished its five-game road trip 3–2 (Hot Hot Hoops) and hosts Cleveland on Friday at 8:00 PM ET (Ball Exclusives, Hot Hot Hoops).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Antetokounmpo's 3-pointer, assisted by Klay Thompson, with 4:51 left in the third quarter, which made it 85–66 from 82–66 (SI.com play-by-play). It was the fourth of his four baskets in the 22–6 run that put Miami up 89–66 (Field Level Media; the play-by-play has the same run, from 67–60). He went 1 for 2 from three. The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Miami Heat or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Antetokounmpo’s listed 6-foot-11 and 250 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to a reported 7-foot-3 wingspan (Heating Up), in the Heat's road red with No. 7 (Eurohoops). It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
